podcast.title: Alt Rock Resurgence of 2004
podcast.body: The Stills were named as one of the new and exciting bands contributing to the resurgence of Alt Rock by 2004. "By 2004, Alt Rock was back with all kinds of new exciting bands that was Franz Ferdinand and Modest Mouse and the Killers and Billy Towns and the Stills and Jet, the Ye-Yaz and Hot Hot Heat."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
